name: Mike Milan
source:
"Mike is a colleague of mine, working at Daikon Industries. He's an extraordinary coder - one of a kind, I'd say - who was hired by Daikon after exposing a flaw on the company's online network. I don't think he's the leaker of the Daikon files, but I have to look into him all the same... better safe than sorry."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonfirestudios/netghost/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
